item.title: Blit 0.2.41
item.description: Faster file lists: the list is now built on AppKit, so switching tabs takes about 50 ms (it was 0.2 s, and about a second in a folder of 10,000 files), and resizing stays just as quick. Dropping onto a folder that's selected in the other pane now works, and dropping onto a file inside an expanded folder lights up the folder it goes into. Tabs switch as soon as the button goes down, and a tab's tag shows only the transfer started from that tab, while it runs.
